evidence.why: Identical child expressions, visibility before command sampling, and early item/model accesses are explicit.

facts.rationale: Adds useful ordering, hierarchy and entry-precondition details absent from the existing summaries without replacing their supported behavior.
facts.value: Visibility uses the item's command variable as it stood on entry, before the continuing path samples the fighter command getter into that variable. Thus the newly sampled value does not affect this invocation's visibility decision. Despite their local names, child and grandchild are both obtained with HSD_JObjGetChild(gobj->hsd_obj), so visibility and scale target the same root child rather than different hierarchy levels. The callback accesses item/model state before its cleanup helpers' null guards and is not a null-tolerant entry point.
